{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.3-0.8 too high compared to true outcomes, indicating overshooting that corrects downward",
    "When sentiment is negative (-0.33), model forecasts exceed true prices by 0.5-2.0, showing sentiment bias isn't fully reflected",
    "True outcomes exhibit stronger mean reversion than model forecasts, especially at horizons beyond 10 days where model remains 0.5-3.0 above reality",
    "Sentiment positive (0.67-1.00) has minimal impact on forecast accuracy differences, suggesting the model over-emphasizes it relative to actual price behavior",
    "The forecast lag effect is most pronounced at 30-day horizon where prices have mean-reverted 1-3 points below model expectations",
    "Model uses linear extrapolation from 18-day history but true prices show more complex momentum that the model captures imperfectly"
] }
